name: Yours Alone
source:
After a year, Wallace and Morana finally reunite, and their plan can finally begin. On this Halloween night, will they succeed in luring Zoé into their trap? 

And will you be able to stop them?

[From [url=https://roku-ta.itch.io/yours-alone]itch.io[/url]]
